Container.Name: gallery-dl
Container.Overview: Docker image for gallery-dl, a command-line program to download image galleries and collections from several image hosting sites.[br][br]The container runs once and exits. Set the URL to download in Post Arguments (Advanced View), and start it on a schedule, e.g. with the User Scripts plugin.
Container.Description: Docker image for gallery-dl, a command-line program to download image galleries and collections from several image hosting sites.[br][br]Place your gallery-dl.conf (and cookies.txt, if the site needs a login) in the AppData directory, then replace the example URL in Post Arguments.

Config.Name: Download Directory
Config.Description: Directory where downloaded media will be saved.

Config.Name: AppData (Config)
Config.Description: Directory containing gallery-dl.conf and an optional cookies.txt. gallery-dl may write refreshed cookies back to cookies.txt.
